notes:
## Changes

- Reduced the default AURIS footer logo on contour sheets for a quieter, better-balanced sidebar in previews and exports. Existing default-sized marks update automatically; custom sizes and organisation logos are preserved.
- Added a coordinate neatline toggle to the sheet toolbar, with clearer hover, selected and keyboard-focus states across the sheet controls.
- Tidied the activity footer with compact progress and time-slice text beside the activity label, a centred progress track, and cyan update/purple save and calculation indicators.
